content: {"answerable": true, "answer": "Yes. As a resident of Canada you report income from outside Canada that you earned after you arrived [s14-c500-000]. For the part of the year after you became a resident, you report your world income, including income from outside Canada [s11-c500-000]. Newcomers who arrived in 2025 file their 2025 return by April 30, 2026 [s14-c500-000][s10-c500-001]."}
